mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to rebound from its trough, weekday foot traffic should spill into nearby retail and recreation trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved from -13.6 at t-2w to -2.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean even though WORKPLACES remains above -5 for the next four weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT improves after a weak period, access friction falls and discretionary trips to retail and recreation rise within two weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC upward.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its t-2w level after being below -8
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -10.4 at t-2w and -4.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks after TRANSIT crosses above -8 from a lower value.

mechanism_narrative: A joint rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a commuting-and-shopping bundle that raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks more than either series alone.
evidence_refs: fact:both series improved from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to outperform its last-4-week average when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while RETAIL_REC remains depressed, a substitution effect emerges as households shift some purchases and leisure back to neighborhood retail, raising RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 5 while RETAIL_REC is below -5
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed between 5.3 and 7.6 while RETAIL_REC stayed negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the next weekly mean after RESIDENTIAL stays above 5 and RETAIL_REC remains below -5.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PARKS weakness signals poor outdoor-destination substitution, so more discretionary time is redirected to retail and recreation, making RETAIL_REC less negative over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose only from -23.6 to -15.7 across the snapshot and stayed deeply negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC becomes more negative over the next 28 days while PARKS remains below -10 throughout the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp upward move in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent plateau indicates local errand consolidation, which should divert some trips into retail corridors and lift RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM increases by at least 2 points week-on-week from a level above 39
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 39.4 at t-0w after peaking at 40.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 2 points from a value above 39.

mechanism_narrative: When both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recover together from negative territory, the commuting recovery should mechanically raise shopping exposure and push RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both series were less negative at t-0w than at t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both trend upward for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL falls back while PARKS remains weak, more out-of-home discretionary time should concentrate in retail venues, producing a higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is positive while PARKS is deeply negative in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL declining and PARKS staying below -15.
